title: Astro Portal session event payload: equipment_issue
description: Reports a problem with equipment during the session: what broke or misbehaved, not the sky (see condition for that). `equipmentId`, when present, names one of the tenant's own inventory items (GET /v1/equipment); it is optional because a field problem is often reported before anyone identifies which piece is at fault. See session-events.md for what this type is for and what it deliberately is not.

severity.description: "blocking" means the session was paused or stopped over it; "minor" means the observer noted it and kept going.
